runs.text: Three pupils have two marks each. Read, for each pupil, their name and their two marks. Show one line per pupil in the format
(a pupil passes with an average of 6 or more, otherwise
with the name. If there is a tie for the best average, the first one read wins.

hints.text: Draw the decomposition tree of this report card. Which branches does it have?
It is the report card of
with two marks and three pupils.
One subprogram for the average, another for the status and the best so far in the main one. Which sign respects the tie?
Replace the best only if the new average is strictly greater. Close with the variant.

runs.text: If there is a tie, show all the tied names.
The first one wins the tie because the comparison is strict. Hidden cases: a tie for first place, everyone failing and an average of exactly 6.0 in the second visible case.
